Title: Aarav's Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vimla - 66 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Aarav stands in the kitchen. Hema stands near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav makes tea for everyone.]

Aarav: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aarav chops onions for the curry.]

Hema (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav washes the dishes after dinner.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav lies down on the sofa.]

Aarav (softly): "How beautiful!"

[Aarav sits down on a chair.]

Aarav (gently): "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav flops down on the sofa.]

Aarav: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Aarav stands by the road. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Aarav rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aarav (laughing): "Okay."

[Aarav hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aarav (laughing): "That was such a fun day!"
